skills.name: addBusinessDays
skills.card:
addBusinessDays — Move a date forward or back by a number of working days — three working days on from a Monday — skipping weekends and holidays.
  needs: date: string, days: integer
  optional: holidays: array
  e.g. "what date is 5 working days from 1 September 2026" → {"date":"2026-09-01","days":5}

date.label: start date
date.prompt: Which date should I start from?

holidays.label: holidays
holidays.description: dates to skip as well as weekends, in YYYY-MM-DD form

examples: what date is 5 working days from 1 September 2026
five working days from 2026-09-01 with a holiday on the third

skills.name: addDuration

from.label: start date
from.prompt: Which date should I start from?

amount.label: how many
amount.prompt: How many should I add? (use a negative number to go back)

skills.name: ageFromDate
skills.card:
ageFromDate — Count how old somebody is from their birthday.
  needs: birthDate: string
  optional: onDate: string
  e.g. "how old is someone born 1990-05-20" → {"birthDate":"1990-05-20"}

birthDate.label: date of birth
birthDate.prompt: What is the date of birth?

examples: how old will a baby born 2026-06-15 be on 2026-12-25
age on a leap-day birthday, born 2004-02-29 on 2026-03-01

skills.name: businessDaysBetween
skills.card:
businessDaysBetween — Count how many working days (Mon–Fri) fall between two dates you give. Does not know public holidays.
  needs: from: string, to: string
  optional: includeStart: boolean
  e.g. "working days between 1 September and 30 September 2026" → {"from":"2026-09-01","to":"2026-09-30"}

from.label: start date
from.prompt: Which date should I count from?

to.label: end date
to.prompt: Which date should I count to?

examples: working days between 1 September and 30 September 2026
how many business days from monday 2026-06-01 to friday 2026-06-05
business days in a full year 2026
working days from 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-07 over a weekend
ten working days from 2026-03-02 counting the first day

skills.name: convertTimezone
skills.card:
convertTimezone — Convert a time from one time zone to another, using IANA zone names.
  needs: time: string, from: string, to: string
  optional: date: string
  e.g. "3pm London in New York on 2026-09-01" → {"time":"15:00","from":"Europe/London","to":"America/New_York","date":"2026-09-01"}

from.label: from time zone
from.prompt: Which time zone is that in?

to.label: to time zone
to.prompt: Which time zone should I convert to?

date.label: date
date.description: a date — defaults to today, and matters because of daylight saving

examples: what is 9am Tokyo in London on 2026-01-15
2:30pm in Berlin is what in Mumbai on 2026-03-20

skills.name: countdownTo

to.label: date
to.prompt: Which date should I count to?

examples: how many days till my sister's wedding on nov 14

skills.name: dateRangeList
skills.card:
dateRangeList — List every date between two dates, optionally stepping by weeks or months.
  needs: from: string, to: string
  optional: step: integer, unit: string, weekdaysOnly: boolean
  e.g. "list the dates from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-05" → {"from":"2026-09-01","to":"2026-09-05"}
examples: the first of each month from january to april 2026

skills.name: dayOfWeek
examples: what day of the week is 14 November 2026
which weekday is 2026-10-31, and is it a sunday
does 25 december 2026 fall on a weekend day

skills.name: dayOfYear
examples: what day of the year is 2026-11-14
which day of the year is christmas 2026
day of year for 2024-03-01 in a leap year

skills.name: daysBetween
skills.card:
daysBetween — Count the days from one given date to another. Takes both dates.
  needs: from: string, to: string
  optional: inclusive: boolean
  e.g. "how many days between 12 July 2026 and 25 December 2026" → {"from":"2026-07-12","to":"2026-12-25"}

from.label: start date
from.prompt: Which date should I count from?

to.label: end date
to.prompt: Which date should I count to?

examples: how many days between 12 July 2026 and 25 December 2026
how long is my trip if I fly out 3 April and back 17 April, counting both days
days between 1 March 2024 and 1 March 2025 (leap year)
